title: PANEL C — 245-Gene Technical QC
summary_rows: 243 endogenous mouse genes + tdTomato + iCre. No further gene discovery is required for the stated ORBm/BMAp, morphine-state, GPCR, plasticity, and cell-identity objectives.
Every endogenous symbol exactly matched the official mouse 2020-A designable list; none matched the official no-probe list.
All endogenous targets are current NCBI symbols and protein-coding genes.
Multi-transcript genes are acceptable for gene-level Xenium design. Isoform-specific interpretation would require separate junction/construct design and is not part of this locked panel.
This is a biological prevalence proxy, not a Xenium probe-efficiency prediction.
Retain for targeted biological roles; interpret non-detection cautiously and review vendor design output.
Each planned ORBm/BMAp anchor has at least four passing in-panel genes; no omitted gene is required to repair anchor coverage.
Exact Ai14 tdTomato and TRAP2 iCreERT2 FASTA sequences are still required. Generic substitutes are not valid.
The 245-gene biology is final. Ordering readiness requires the two exact reporter FASTAs and a successful Xenium Panel Designer review.
